content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages serves as a free hosting solution for static websites, making it an ideal choice for digital creators looking to sell products such as ebooks, templates, and software without incurring platform fees. By leveraging GitHub Pages, you can set up an online store that is not only cost-effective but also provides full ownership of your content and customer data. This infrastructure empowers creators to bypass traditional payment structures, allowing you to retain more revenue compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut on sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves several key components working together seamlessly. GitHub Pages hosts your product listings, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers manage backend logic, such as processing orders and delivering products. NOWPayments integrates as the payment processor, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% fee. This combination ensures that when a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, and the product is delivered instantly, all without the interference of conventional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in countries where major payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. If you're selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or digital assets in regions like Nigeria or Venezuela, this architecture allows you to reach your audience directly without the barriers imposed by conventional financial systems. By deploying your own digital storefront, you gain autonomy over your sales and customer interactions, essential for building a sustainable online business.
GitHub Pages allows free and reliable hosting for your digital storefront.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of your digital store include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Each component plays a critical role in the user experience. With GitHub Pages, you have a reliable and free hosting solution. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers enable you to automate product delivery and order management, while NOWPayments allows for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you retain the maximum revenue from your sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your own digital product store, first, create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your website. Next, upload your product files and create an HTML page to showcase your offerings. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, such as processing orders. Finally, set up NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments efficiently. For a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which offers all the blueprints and templates you need to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider setting up a digital store using GitHub Pages along with a backend automation tool like Google Apps Script. With the help of NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can accept payments while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional platforms. This infrastructure allows you to maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
NOWPayments keeps transaction fees at just 0.5%, optimizing your profits.

Start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository for your project. Upload your digital product files to the repository. Develop a simple HTML page to showcase your products. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order processing and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly. Test your setup to ensure everything works correctly before promoting your store.
